package.name: application
package.description: Autonomy bring-up for the Unitree B2. Assembles a robot (the MuJoCo stand-in or the physical machine), the lidar_slam perception chain, LiDAR odometry, SLAM and Nav2 into one launch. The robot layer is a launch argument because both options expose the same interface, so nothing below this package knows which one is running. Also carries the B2-specific tuning, saved maps and teleop helpers.
